In differentiated myofibres, we observed that Wnt7a binding to Fzd7 directly activates the Akt/mTOR growth pathway, thereby inducing myofibre hypertrophy. Notably, the Fzd7 receptor complex was associated with Gα(s) and PI(3)K and these components were required for Wnt7a to activate the Akt/mTOR growth pathway in myotubes.
